text.body:
॥ śivakeśādipādāntavarṇanastotram ॥
deyāsurmūdhniṃ rājassarasasurasaritpāraparyantaniryatprāṃśustambāḥ piśaṅgāstulitapariṇatāraktaśālīlatāvaḥ । durvārāpattigartaśritanisvilajanottāraṇe rajjubhūtā ghorāghorvīruhālīdahanaśikhiśikhāḥ śarma śāvā kapardāḥ ।।1 kurvannirvāṇamārgapragamaparilasadrūpyasopānaśaṅkāṃ śakrārīṇāmpurāṇāṃ trayavijayakṛtaspaṣṭarekhāyamāṇam । avyādavyājamuccairalikahimaparādhityakāntanidhodyajjāhnavyābhaṃ mṛḍānīkamituruḍaparukpāṇḍaraṃ vastripuṇḍram ॥2 krudhyadgaurīprasādānatisamayapadāṅguṣṭhasaṅkrānta lākṣābinduspardhismarāreḥ sphaṭikamaṇidṛṣanmanmagnamāṇikyaśobham । mūrdhanyudyaddivyasindhoḥ patitaśapharikākāri vomāstakaṃstādastokāpaṃttikṛtyai hutavaha kaṇikā mokṣarūkṣaṃ sadākṣi ॥3 bhūtyai dṛgbhūtayoḥ syādyadahimahimarugbimbayoḥ snigdhavarṇo daityauṣadhvaṃsaśaṃsīsphuṭaiva pariveṣāvaśeṣo vibhāti । sargasthityantavṛttirmayisamupagate'tīvanirvṛttagarvaṃ śārvāṇībharturuccaiyugalamathadadhadvibhramaṃtabhdruvorvaḥ ॥4 yugmerukmābjapiṅge grahaiva pihite drāsyayoḥ prāgduhitrā śailasya dhvāntanīlāmbararacitabṛhatkañcuko'bhūtprapañcaḥ । te trainetre pavitre tridaśavaraghaṭāmitrajaitro praśasne netrenetre bhavetāṃ drutamiha bhavatāmindriyāśvānniyantum ॥5 caṇḍīvakrārpaṇecchostadanu bhagavataḥ pāṇḍurukpāṇḍugaṇḍaprodyatkaṇḍaṃ vinetuṃ vitanutaiva ye ratnakoṇairvidhṛṣṭim । caṇḍārcimaṇḍalābhe satatanatajjanadhvāntakhaṇḍātiśauṇḍe cāṇḍīśete śriye stāmadhikamavanatākhaṇḍale kuṇḍale vaḥ॥ 6 khaṭvāṅgodaprapāṇeḥ sphuṭavikaṭapuṭovakrarandhrapraveśaprepsūdañcatsphaṇoruśvasadatidhavalāhīndraśaṅkāṃdadhānaḥ । yuṣmākaṃ kamravakrāmburuhaparilasatkarṇikākāraśobhā śaśvattrāṇāya bhūyādasamativimalottuṅgakoṇaḥ saghoṇaḥ ॥7 krudhyatyaddhā yayoḥ svāṃ tanumatilasatorbimbatāṃlakṣayantī bhartre spardhātinighnāmuhuritaravadhūśaṅkayā śailakanyā yuṣmāṃstauśaśvaduccairabahuladaśamīśarvarīśātiśubhrāvavyāstāṃ divyasindhoḥ kamituravanamallokapālokapolau ॥8 yo bhāsā bhāntyupāntasthitaiva nibhṛtaṃ kaustubhodraṣṭumicchansosthasnehāśritāntaṃ galagatagaralaṃ patyuruccaiḥ paśūnām । prodyatpremṇāyamārdrā pibati girisutāsampadaḥ sātirekā lokāśśoṇīkṛtāntā yadadharamahasāso'dharovovidhattām ॥9 atyarthaṃ rājate yā badanaśaśadharādudgalaccāruvāṇīpīyūṣāmbhaḥ pravāhaprasaraparilasatphenavindvāpalīva। deyātsā dantapaktiściramiha danudāyādadauvārikasya dyutyā dīptendukundacchaviramalatarapronnatāgrāmudaṃ vaḥ ॥10 nyakkurvannuvarābhṛgnimaghanasamayoddhuṣṭameghaughaghoṣaṃ sphūrjadvāyusthitorudhvanitamapi parabrahmabhūto gabhīrḥ। sudhyakto vyaktamūrteḥ prakaṭitakaraṇaḥ prāṇanāthasya satyāḥ prītyā vaḥ saṃvidadhyātphalavikalamalaṃ janmanādaḥ sanādaḥ ॥11 bhāsā yasya trilokī lasatiparilasatphenabindurṇavāntarvyamagne vāti gaurastulitasurasaridvāripūraprasāraḥ। pīnātmā dantabhābhirbhṛśamahahuhakārāvibhīmaḥ sadeṣṭāṃ puṣṭāṃ tuṣṭiṃ kṛṣīṣṭa sphuṭamiha bhavatāmahahāmo'ṣṭamūrteḥ ।।12 sadyo jātākhyamāpyaṃ yaduvimalamudamvarti yadvāmadevaṃ nāmnā hemnā sadṛkṣaṃ jaladanibhmaghorāhvaryaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ yat । yadbālarkaprabhaṃ sarapuruṣanigaditaṃ pūrvamīśānasaṃjñaṃ yaddivyaṃ tāni śambhorbhavadabhilaṣitaṃ paścavadyurmukhāni ॥13 ātmapremṇo bhavānyā svayamiva racitāḥ sādaraṃ sāṃvananyā mahya tisṛḥ sunīlāñjananibhagararekhāḥ samābhānti yasyām । ākalpānarupabhāsā bhṛśaruciratarā kambukalyānvikāyāḥ patyuḥ sātyantamantarvilasatu satataṃ mantharākandharā vaḥ ॥ 14 vatendrodantalakṣmyāściramadharamahākaustubhasyāntarāle srotthānāṃ prārthayan yaḥ sthitimacalabhuve vārayantyai niveśam । prāyukta vāśiṣo yaḥ pratipadamamṛtatve sthitaḥ kālaśatroḥ kālaṃ kurvan galaṃ vo hṛdayamalamalaṃ kṣālayet kārakūṭaḥ॥15 prauḍhapremākulāyādṛḍhataraparirambheṣu parvendumuravyāḥ pārvatyāścārucāmīkaravalayapadairaṅkitaṃ kāntiśāli । raṅgannāgāṅgadāḍhyaṃ satatamavihitaṃ karma nirmūlayettaddormūlaṃ nirmalaṃ yaddhṛdiduritamapāsyārjitaṃ dhūrjaṭervaḥ ॥16 kaṇṭhāśleṣamāptādivaivakamituḥ svargasindhoḥ pravāhāḥ krāntyai saṃsārasindhoḥ sphaṭikamaṇimahāsaṅkramākāradīrdhāḥ । tiryagviṣkambhabhūtāstribhuvanavasatebhinnadaityebhadehā bāhāvastāharasyadrutamihanivahānaṃhasāṃ saṃharantu ॥17 vakṣodakṣadviṣo'laṃ smarabharavinamaddakṣajākṣīṇa vakṣojāntarnikṣiptaśumbhanmalayajamilatodbhāsibhasmokṣitaṃyat । kṣipraṃ tadrūkṣacakṣuḥ śrutigaṇaphaṇaratnaughabhābhīkṣṇaśobhaṃ yuṣmākaṃ śaśvadenaḥ sphaṭikamaṇiśilāmaṇḍalābhaṃ kṣiṇotu ॥ 18 muktāmukte vicitrākulavalilaharī jālaśālinyavāñcannābhyāvarte viloladbhujagavarayute kālaśatrorviśāle। yuṣmañcitratridhāmā pratinavarucire mandire kāntilakṣmyāḥ śītāṃ śīsāṃśugaure cirataramudarakṣīrasindhau salīlam ॥ vaiyāghrī yatra kṛttiḥ sphurati himagirervistṛtopatyakāntaḥ sāndrāvaśyāyamiśrāparitaivavṛtā nīlajīmūtamālā। āmbaddhāhīndrakāñcīguṇamatiputhulaṃ śailajākrīḍabhūmistadvo niḥśreyase syājjaghanamatidhanaṃ bālaśītāṃśumauleḥ।।20 puṣṭāvaṣṭambhabhūtau pṛthutarajaghanasyāpi nityaṃ trilokyāḥ samyagvṛttau surendrādviradavarakarodārakāntiṃ dadhānau । sārābūrū purāreḥ prasabhamarighaṭāghasmarau bhasmaśubhrau bhaktairatyārdracittairadhikamavanatau vāñchitaṃ vo vidhattām ॥21 ānandāyendukāntopalaracitasamudgāyite ye munīnāṃ cittādarśaṃ nidhātuṃ vidadhati caraṇetāṇḍavākuścanāni । kāñcī bhogīndramūrdhā pratimuhurupadhānāyamāne kṣaṇaṃ te kāntestāmantakārerdyutivijitasudhābhānunī jānunī vaḥ ॥ 11 mañjīrībhūtabhogipravaragaṇaphaṇāmaṇḍalāntarnitāntavyādīrghānargharatnadyutikisalayite stūyamānedyusadbhiḥ। bibhratyau vibhramaṃ vaḥ sphaṭikamaṇibṛhaddaṇḍavadbhāsite ye jaṅghe śaṅkhanduśubhre bhṛśamiha bhaktāṃ mānase śūlapāṇeḥ ॥23 astokastomaśastraipacitimamalāṃbhūribhāvopahāraiḥ kurvadbhissarvadoṣaiḥ satatamabhivṛtau brahmaviddevalādyaiḥ। samyaksampūjyamānāviha hṛdisarasīvāniśaṃ yuṣmadīye śarvasya kīṅatāṃ tau prapadavarabṛhatkacchapāvacchabhāsau ॥24 yāḥ svasyaikāṃśapātādatibahulagaladrakta vaktraṃ praṇunnaprāṇaṃ prākrośayan prāṅnijamacalavaraṃ cālayantaṃ daśāsyam । pādāṅgulyo diśantu drutamayugadṛśaḥ kasmaṣaploploṣakalyāḥ kalyāṇaṃ phullamālyaprakaravilasitā vaḥ praṇaddhāhivallabhaḥ ।।25 prahvḥ prācīnabarhiḥ pramukhasuravaraprasphuranmaulisaktajyāyoratnotkarosnairaviratamamalā bhūrinīrājitāyā। prodagrāgrā pradeyāttatiriva rucirātārakāṇāṃ nitāntaṃ nīlagrīvasya pādāmburuhavilasitāsrānakhālīsukhaṃ vaḥ ॥ 26 satyāḥ satyānanendāvapi savidhagate ye vikāsaṃdadhāte svānte svānte labhante śriyamihasarasīvāmarāyedadhānaḥ। lola lolambakānāṃ kulamivasudhiyāṃ sevate yesadāstāṃ bhūtyai bhūtyaiṇapāṇervimalatararucastepadāmbhoruhe vaḥ॥27 yeṣāṃ rāgādidoṣākṣatamiti yatayo yānti mukti prasādādyevā namrātmamūrtirdyusaduṣipariṣanmūrdhniśeṣāyamāṇāḥ। śrīkaṇṭhasyāruṇodyaccaraṇasarasijaprotthitāste bhavākhyātpārāvārācciraṃ vo duritahatikṛtastārayeyuḥ parāgāḥ ॥28 bhūmnā yasyāstasīsnā bhuvanamanusṛtaṃ yatparaṃ dhāmadhānnāṃ sāmnāmāmnāyatatvaṃ yadapi ca paramaṃ yadguṇātītamādyam । yaccāhohannirīhaṃ gahanamitimuhuḥ prāhuruccairmahānto māheśaṃ tanmaho me mahitamaharaharmoharohaṃ nihantu ॥29 iti śrīmatparamahaṃsa parivrājakācāryasya śrīgovindabhagavatpūjyapādaśiṣyasya śrīmacchaṅkarabhagavataḥ kṛtau ॥ śivakeśādipādāntavarṇanastotraṃ sampūrṇam ॥
